title: Settlement Basis: Loading an Amendment Charge Where the Package Has Been Amended Before
content:
Where amendment or name-change charges already stand on the ledger of a package among the Vacation Package Products and the package record stands at confirmed, the charge now being withheld carries a loading. The charges counted are the amendment charges and the name-change charges standing against that package, taken together as one count.

**More than one already standing.** Where the package ledger already carries more than one amendment or name-change charge — a combined count of 2 or more — and the package record stands at confirmed, the loading is the whole of it increased by the repeat-amendment allowance published for this calculation, which is 8 per cent.

**Exactly one already standing.** Where the package ledger already carries exactly one amendment or name-change charge — a combined count of exactly 1 — and the package record stands at confirmed, the loading is the whole of it increased by the first-amendment allowance published for this calculation, which is 4 per cent.

**Otherwise.** Where the combined count is 0, or the package record stands at anything other than confirmed, no loading of this kind is added.

| Amendment and name-change charges already on the ledger | Package record stands at | Loading added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | confirmed | 8 per cent |
| exactly 1 | confirmed | 4 per cent |
| 0 | confirmed | none of this kind |
| any count | quoted, deposit held, travelling, completed, cancelled or closed | none of this kind |

*Worked hypothetically.* A charge of 200.00 USD before loading, on a package standing at confirmed whose ledger already carries 3 such charges, is loaded to 216.00 USD. The same charge on a package standing at confirmed whose ledger carries exactly 1 is loaded to 208.00 USD. The same charge on a package standing at deposit held carries no loading of this kind, whatever its ledger shows.
